explain.say: A face is a flat surface. A cube has 6 square faces: the top, the bottom and 4 around the sides. That is why a dice shows the numbers 1 to 6! Can you count the faces on a box?

explain.say: An edge is where two faces meet, a straight line. A vertex is a corner, where edges meet. A cube has 12 edges and 8 vertices. Run your finger along the edges of a box: did you count 12?

explain.say: Now the square pyramid: 1 square face at the bottom and 4 triangle faces, so 5 faces. It has 8 edges and 5 vertices, 4 at the bottom and 1 at the top. Which shape has more corners?

explain.say: Wonderful detective work! Curved shapes are different: a cylinder has 2 flat faces and no corners, and a cone has 1 flat face and one point. Wow: for a cube, faces plus vertices take away edges makes 2, and it works for the pyramid too!

faq.q: How many faces does a cube have?
faq.a: A cube has 6 faces, and every face is a square of the same size. A dice is a cube, so it shows 6 numbers.
asks: How many sides does a cube have?

faq.q: How many vertices does a pyramid have?
faq.a: A square-based pyramid has 5 vertices: 4 corners around the square base and 1 at the top.
asks: How many corners does a pyramid have?

faq.a: An edge is the line where two faces meet. A cube has 12 edges: 4 round the top, 4 round the bottom and 4 going up the sides.
asks: What does edge mean in 3D shapes?

faq.a: A vertex is a corner where edges meet. The word for more than one is vertices. A cube has 8 vertices.

faq.q: What is the faces plus vertices rule?
faq.a: For shapes with flat faces and straight edges, faces plus vertices take away edges always equals 2. For a cube, 6 plus 8 take away 12 is 2. It is called Euler's formula.

facts: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.
A square-based pyramid has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices.
For shapes like these, faces + vertices − edges = 2; this is Euler's formula.

A square pyramid has 1 square face and 4 triangle faces: 5.
